evals.prompt: I'm building a maintenance scheduling app. Users need to see a list of all assets, pick one, view its upcoming maintenance tasks, and create new tasks. What screen structure should I use?
evals.expected_output: A screen architecture recommendation using Frappe ecosystem conventions (sidebar-list-detail or equivalent)
expectations: Recommends a list/detail split (sidebar asset list + main detail panel) as used in Frappe CRM and Helpdesk
Distinguishes when a full-page navigation (route change) is appropriate vs an inline detail pane
Identifies the 'create new task' action as a slide-in or dialog pattern consistent with Frappe conventions, not a full new page
Does not implement Vue code; delivers a structural pattern recommendation only

evals.prompt: Our app has a 'Delete Project' action that removes all associated records. What confirmation pattern should we use so users don't accidentally trigger it?
evals.expected_output: A recommendation for a destructive-action confirmation pattern consistent with frappe-ui conventions
expectations: Recommends a confirmation dialog (not a toast or inline warning) for irreversible destructive actions
Suggests requiring the user to type the project name or click a distinctly styled danger button as a secondary confirmation
References the pattern used in Frappe's own UI (e.g. delete confirmation in Desk) as precedent
Does not implement the dialog component; stays at the pattern/design level
